profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Nemean Solutions, LLC
profile.summary:
Languages: C#, VB.NET, Java, Python, Objective-C, Swift, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Typescript.
Frameworks/Platforms: .NET, ASP.NET, JSP/JSF, React, Docker.
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL
IDEs: Visual Studio, Xcode, Eclipse.
Version Control: Git/Gitlab, TFS, SVN.
Atlassian Suite: Jira, Bitbucket, Confluence, etc.
OS: Windows, MacOS, Linux, iOS, Android.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Software development and support for US Army's Command and Control Support Agency (CCSA) and the US Army's G 3-5-7 division.
- Full stack development using .NET/ASP.NET Core, C#, & SQL Server
- Deployment of services and systems using Azure DevOps
- Leveraging AI agents to optimize workflows and accelerate software development.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Tysons Corner, Virginia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Agile driven software development supporting various US Govt Agencies
- Full stack development for the eMASS platform
- Backend development using .NET/ASP.NET Core, C#, & SQL Server
- Front development using JavaScript, HTML, & XML

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Team Lead
positions.description:
-Led a DevOps team, collaborating with clients on requirements and updates.
-Developed multi-project solutions using C#, Java, Python, & Objective-C on various platforms.
-Created testing frameworks in Python and managed development devices.
-Maintained company internal communication systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Code Review · English · Algorithms · Team Management · Engineering Management · Team Leadership

positions.title: Software Developer / Team Lead
positions.description:
-Lead a team delegating responsibilities for various projects
-Developed full-stack and client-facing applications using C# .NET & SQL.
-Modernized 30-year-old legacy software by porting it to C# .NET.
positions.insights: Skills: Code Review · English · Algorithms · Team Management · Engineering Management · Team Leadership

positions.title: Mobile & Web Developer
positions.description:
-Front-End development for banking institutions using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, & ASP.Net
-Full-Stack development for internal applications using Java, C#
-Android development under a Scrum/Agile processes.

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-op

-Built backend web systems in Java and managed PostgreSQL databases.
-Delivered tailored web solutions for telecommunications clients.
